scripts.setup: uv sync --locked --extra dev && uv run playwright install chromium
scripts.check:api:static: uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy apps/api/src/hawkeye
scripts.check:core: pnpm check:web && pnpm build && pnpm check:api && git diff --check
scripts.package: pnpm build && uv run python tools/release/build_package.py
scripts.package:windows: pnpm build && uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra desktop && uv run python tools/release/build_windows.py
scripts.verify:manual: pnpm build && uv run python tools/verification/verify_manual.py
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['apps/api/src/hawkeye/review_app/static','apps/api/src/judolgraph_hawkeye.egg-info','build','dist','judolgraph_hawkeye.egg-info']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.clean:cache: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['.mypy_cache','.pytest_cache','.ruff_cache']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
